audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. Missing restriction on epsilon0 permits vanishing lengths and an undefined count ratio on events whose probabilities tend to one.; Factoring g^(3-4s+epsilon) incorrectly changes the exponent to 3-epsilon.; The general-j recursion uses d2 instead of dj, and the zero-index monotonicity step compares a negative-index zero to a positive volume.
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: The p5 remark uses L->infinity, and the actual Theorem49 explicitly assumes epsilon0 in (0,1). The diverging-length transition is not refuted.

F2 — Counterevidence: The next source line already uses the correct g^(-1+epsilon). After restoring the plus sign, logt/(logt-4logg)<=1+4logg/log2 and the harmonic sum are absorbed in the stated small exponent loss; gLi(sqrt(t))<=C g^-1 Li(t).
F3 — Counterevidence: The second example does not refute the whole (52), since discarded positive terms may compensate. Actual (53) uses j2 and b=ceil((d1+2)/2)>=1; both identified cases are avoided.
F4 — Counterevidence: Lemma48 has the correct mean ~Li(e^L)/2, while I~Li(e^L)/4. Restoring both coefficients preserves cancellation.
Not performed: Independent full proofs of Selberg,Wolpert,Mirzakhani,Otal-Rosas,Monk,[WX22],[LW24] and cited Weil-Petersson volume asymptotics.
Not performed: Full reconstruction of orbital-subsurface estimates pp51-53 or geometric shortening Theorem65.
Not performed: Publisher-text equivalence, author-code execution, human review.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Missing restriction on epsilon0 permits vanishing lengths and an undefined count ratio on events whose probabilities tend to one.

Factoring g^(3-4s+epsilon) incorrectly changes the exponent to 3-epsilon.

The general-j recursion uses d2 instead of dj, and the zero-index monotonicity step compares a negative-index zero to a positive volume.

The first and ordered two-curve moments omit factors two and four.
